input.quote: No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies. Customer pays only for Services ordered in a mutually executed Order Form, and its decision not to enter another Order Form is not a breach or shortfall.
input.rationale: The Agreement meets the preferred position: § 2.1 expressly disclaims any minimum quantity or purchase commitment, confirms we pay only for Services ordered under an executed Order Form, and states that declining to place further orders is neither a breach nor a shortfall. This is reinforced by § 12 (p0051), where Vendor acknowledges we have made no exclusivity or minimum-volume commitment, and by § 7.1 (p0026), which bars any unstated minimum-use charge. No take-or-pay, committed spend, non-reducible seat count, or volume cap on our usage appears anywhere; the only "shortfall" concept is the licence-audit true-up in § 22, which is a usage reconciliation rather than a purchase commitment. § 8.2 also gives us a 30 days' non-renewal right on each Order Form, so no commitment persists without an exit.
